formats.summary: archiveMode becomes the stamped object, and the archive holds two more stores: the agent-history evidence (archive/agent-history.db) and its read model (derived/agent-history-read-model.db). Device capture policy defaults to browsing on and conversations off on older controls. Before setup, optional onboardingChoices remembers this installation’s selected kinds, tool checklist and Git preference. Initialization consumes the draft without granting roots. Browsing task dismissals use namespaced archive_meta rows at the released Archive schema 23 and Intelligence schema 2. Run dismissals travel with the ledger. Move import clears acknowledgements of the omitted queues. The optional captureInstallation field binds capture choices and hints to the installation that made them. Unbound and foreign choices give fresh defaults. Reader preferences, scratch paths and optional Agent AI access switches are bound to this installation and omitted from portable controls. Explicit off, an intentionally empty tool checklist and dismissed conversation hints are local to the device. A choice-free device shows saved transcripts as paused. The device policy can reference an immutable root selection and a pending first save. Restore and import keep the destination policy. The read model holds versioned source and conversation publications, root summary seek keys, original turn and response facts, branch-specific prompt directories, and screen record/attachment locators. Conversation search adds source and card epoch selectors, a dirty card set, serving epoch/root count and Tantivy schema 3 with typed readable roles and native titles. Evidence also owns generated project IDs and versioned project choices with undo. The read model carries project membership, lookup keys and folder/tool rollups. Agent Insights adds evidence-side viewer preferences and publication-owned temporal facts, coverage extents and UTC clock-hour rollups to R. Evidence migration 61 and read-model migration 113 append ah_pair_seal after the existing migrations. Evidence 67 and read-model 189 preserve existing preferences and navigation or work keys when an earlier seed is pending, and restore the seal table empty if it is missing. Marked native safety copies preserve unreadable conversation bytes. Verified evidence from a marked copy can supply a repair. A displaced held generation is sealed as a separately listed copy before release. Manual and pre-repair copies are listed and individually freeable. Read-model migrations 190 and 191 refresh existing subagent links and types. Evidence migrations 68 through 72 record an archive origin, newly introduced conversations and undo eligibility. A move file of this revision is format 3 and carries the encrypted intelligence-originals row stream. The v0.5 rollback receipt and standalone conversation package live beside the product root. The snapshot beside this file is the shape of every listed record as the code stands; until a release writes revision 1 it may be edited in place.
formats.olderBuilds: PathKeep 0.4.0 and 0.5.0 cannot parse the stamped archiveMode and stop at start, before any service runs. Before reading the config they act only on records under their own names (.pk-wipe-in-progress.json, archive/.pk-import-journal.json), which revision 1 does not write. They refuse a format-3 move file before asking for its password.
